title: Vice President of Operations
text:
Vice President of Operations

**Good Hearts Gear**

Position Summary

Good Hearts Gear is seeking a strategic, hands-on Vice President of Operations to lead and scale our operational infrastructure. This executive will oversee day-to-day operations while building the systems, processes, and performance standards needed to support growth, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and healthy margins.

The VP of Operations will lead key functions including supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, vendor management, production coordination, process improvement, and customer support operations. This role will also oversee the operational execution of private label and custom product programs, ensuring strong quality, timelines, and scalable processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operations leader who can think strategically, execute effectively, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, e-commerce, and leadership to support revenue growth and product launch success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage overall operations for Good Hearts Gear, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and scalability
* Develop and improve operational systems, workflows, SOPs, controls, and KPIs
* Oversee inventory planning, purchasing, fulfillment, logistics, warehousing, and vendor performance
* Improve inventory accuracy, service levels, order accuracy, and cost efficiency
* Lead operational execution for private label and custom product initiatives from development through delivery
* Manage vendor and factory relationships, production timelines, quality standards, sampling, and compliance
* Build repeatable processes for product specifications, approvals, launch readiness, and fulfillment
* Partner with sales, marketing, and e-commerce teams to align operations with demand planning, promotions, launches, and customer expectations
* Monitor operational performance, margin support, productivity, and service quality through dashboards and reporting
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team focused on accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, including 3–5 years in a senior leadership role
* Experience in apparel, branded merchandise, promotional products, consumer products, e-commerce, distribution, or light manufacturing strongly preferred
* Proven success managing supply chain, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, and vendor relationships
* Experience supporting private label, custom product programs, and product development operations
* Strong background in process improvement, SOP development, KPI reporting, and operational scaling
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with sales, marketing, e-commerce, and finance
* Familiarity with ERP, inventory management, order management, and reporting systems
* Experience supporting wholesale and/or big box retail requirements is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field preferred

**Key Skills**

* Strategic operations leadership
* Supply chain and inventory management
* Fulfillment and distribution optimization
* Private label and custom product operations
* Vendor and factory management
* Product development coordination
* Process improvement and performance management
* Financial and margin awareness
* Cross-functional leadership and executive communication

*Full job description available upon request, and will be provided when an interview request is made.*

Pay: From $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
